scope: Article argument through a spring calculation and Hamiltonian-learning construction.
method: Deterministic local rendering; separate WebVTT captions with progressive inline presentation and native fallback; no generative video API.
synthetic_narration: Supertonic 2 F1; local inference; disclosed in video and article.
audio_rights: MIT inference code; BigScience OpenRAIL-M model. Model section6 disclaims output rights except as stated; use restrictions apply. AttachmentA(e) requires synthetic-content disclosure, supplied in video and transcript. No macOS system-voice recording is included.
numeric_conditions: Normalized h=0.1, 2000 steps, q0=1,u0=0. Teaching calculation, not a matched-cost benchmark.

interpretation_limits.model: Undamped undriven horizontal linear spring, fixed mass and stiffness.
interpretation_limits.comparison_scope: Same h teaching calculation, not an equal-cost or equal-accuracy benchmark.
interpretation_limits.HNN: Smooth autonomous learned function in canonical coordinates; Hamilton equations conserve it in continuous time. Learned physical accuracy and discrete integration error remain separate tests.

human_review: No human listening, pronunciation or reader-comprehension study.

article_player_checks.accessibility: MP4/VTT/visual-transcript TXT downloads only; no expanded transcript or production panel. Four JavaScript-off native fallback and four CC-toggle cases passed.
article_player_checks.audio_scope: Browser playback checked muted. Existing PCM/decode checks unchanged; no new listening/pronunciation/comprehension study.
article_player_checks.print: Visible print element text/geometry identical to previous layout: 97 elements per language. Existing PDFs and archive copies unchanged.
article_player_checks.independent_caption_visual_review: Chromium/WebKit screenshots at mobile and desktop widths reviewed. No horizontal overflow, duplicated captions, text clipping or artificial picture-to-caption gap.
article_player_checks.media_scope: Web player and layout only; MP4, poster, VTT and TXT bytes unchanged.
article_player_checks.native_pip_scope: Native fallback branch implemented; no physical-device picture-in-picture verification.
